journeyGroups.why: Why now: Emily's Engineering department selection reduced the displayed directory to eight employees and changed pagination to one page, with a matching successful filtered API response. Observations: 5 and 6 (Emily.dawson).

scenarios.name: Filter the employee directory by department
scenarios.gherkin:
Given Emily.dawson is viewing the employee directory
When she selects Engineering in the department filter
Then the directory displays 8 Engineering employees on page 1 of 1 with Previous and Next disabled
And the employee directory request returns HTTP 200 with department Engineering, total 8, and pages 1
